q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of paper envelopes?
title: Paper envelope carbon footprint per kg
short: Envelopes are mostly paper: take the paper mill's figure per tonne for the grade used, add adhesive, window film and ink, then add cutting, folding, gumming and printing energy per kg of envelopes made.

ul: Window film and printing ink if used.

p: Report per kg, or per thousand envelopes by size. Recycled paper usually lowers the figure.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 5,680 / 40,000 = 0.142 kg CO2 per kg
Add paper, adhesive and ink for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
